judge_input.description:
#### Please go ahead and describe the changes that are in your PR here. If it happens to be the case that it is addressing an issue, then please go ahead and reference that issue as well.

What we had here was a trickle of PRs coming in from the community, and those PRs were ones that went and found issues:
- LLM: https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/3422
- STT: https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/3351

What this one right here does is apply that very same fix, and it applies it for TTS, for OpenAI Realtime, and for Gemini Live.

On top of that, the changelogs are being updated as well so that they end up being consistent.
judge_input.diff_patch:
diff --git a/changelog/3351.fixed.md b/changelog/3351.fixed.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..2792839cb0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/changelog/3351.fixed.md
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+- Fixed an issue in `traced_stt` where `model_name` in OpenTelemetry appears as `unknown`.
diff --git a/changelog/3422.fixed.md b/changelog/3422.fixed.md

@@ -1 +1 @@
-- Fixed a bug in `traced_llm` where the model name in opentelemetry is shown unknown even though it is defined.
+- Fixed an issue in `traced_llm` where `model_name` in OpenTelemetry appears as `unknown`.
diff --git a/changelog/3428.fixed.md b/changelog/3428.fixed.md
new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+- Fixed an issue in `traced_tts`, `traced_gemini_live`, and `traced_openai_realtime` where `model_name` in OpenTelemetry appears as `unknown`.
